entry_points.text: Exit keeps low-8 never returning, group coordinates peers; wait covers info/legacy PID/PGID/all with user publish where faults fail; compat keeps semantics.
Fork uses child-signal notify centrally; clone3 stages ids/validates/delegates; idle binds all ids; IO workers share fs/files/memory untraced; unshare forwards flags.
Getgroups queries/copies with distinct faults; setgroups needs privilege with sorted import; hung timeout wakes supervisor; kcov creates entry plus per-CPU pools.
Native validates/duplicates/invokes/frees, compat translates; file installs/removes with screening/staging/publish; restart notifies/blocks/shuts; headers at boot.

exports.text: Exe lookup returns new ref or null skipping kthreads; mm create/final/async release and cross-task access gate lifetime; final task free needs exited zero-ref non-current.
Accounting fills times/ids/creds/faults/command plus integrals and IO totals; fork/live counters track population; text accepts core plus module/BPF via oracles.
Creation validates opts/notify, duplicates, traces, resolves id, handles vfork wakeup; thread helpers force shared untraced entry; stop query reads flag.
Namespaces retained or rebuilt with privilege checks; pid validated then published; pidfd installs live linkage; thaw wakes threads; seccomp shares filter.
Map tries cached modes, failing on empty/mixed RAM/alias; managed binds to device; irq work drains promptly with sync wait; kcmp orders identities by type.
Open creates disabled refcounted object; control validates sizes/modes/handles; mapping needs exact range; remote start attaches, stop detaches and merges.
Handoff declines when busy/unstaged else prepares to machine layer; staging needs cap plus allowance; map gathers sources; ELF stages loadables; erase poisons stacks.

hazards.text: Exit from IRQ/idle, repeated-fault bound, weak abort, freeing init/current mm, task put with refs/unexited and overflow markers divert to warn/fault/halt.
Reserve/clone/option-id checks, user copy of status/info/usage and kcov size/offset/double-use failures abort releasing partial state; offline queued work warns.
Pre-dup pending, pidfd alias/stack/opts, exec-race fs, freezer and vfork checks required; concurrent kexec busy; uninstall null-exchanges; map null on failure.
Mixed RAM and incompatible alias warn; hung reporting stops after budget, threshold panics; overlap/type and permission/lockdown/flag violations deny.

invariants.text: Stop/continue selects tracer or group-leader parent with namespaced ids/times/reason; wait validates opts, resolves ALL/PID/PGID/PIDFD; nonblock maps no-progress to retry.
Taskstats skips without family/listeners; single exit one record, group adds aggregate; broadcasts use per-CPU seq, clone except last; integrals need user mm after tick.
VM shared or duplicated with exec following; fs/files/sighand shared or copied, fs refused in exec; threads share signal else fresh; bad ns/thread/pidfd combos rejected.
Unpriv sharing allows at most new user with time/VM else admin; pidns checks depth/ancestry/count; clone3 enforces versions/signals; unshare checks thread; freeze exempts non-freezable.
Hung scan counts, reports within budget, panics at threshold, skips after fatal taint; RAM reuses direct mapping when allowed; overlap disjoint/intersecting/mixed; addrs mixed with secrets.
Handles auth by subsystem/instance masks; areas match exact length/class; buffers use leading count, drop overflow, publish count first; mode ignores switch flag.
Descriptors need aligned non-wrapping disjoint ranges within half memory, crash inside reservation; full tables link via indirection; validation orders permission/mediation/lockdown.
File prep reads/probes/signals/checks cmdline then loads; hashes retained segments omitting purgatory; ELF needs sane headers; placement aligns, crash stays in reserve.

locks.text: Handler lock serializes notify, group-exit and group store; listeners share for clone/deliver, exclusive for prune; tasklist lock is outermost.
Task lock samples mm, RCU holds exe past section, exec lock guards access with ptrace checks; exe swap denies writes under write lock; new mm inits rwsem/locks.
Sighand/seccomp under parent irq-disabled lock; linkage under tasklist exclusive; ids under map lock with retry; freezer spin covers freezable, sched lock frozen step.
Kcmp orders locks by address; irq drain assumes disabled irqs with handover; kcov instance lock guards mode/buffer, table lock handles; kexec guard gives busy.
One mutex serializes fault list/values; each kexec allowance has own mutex, negative means unlimited; cached stacks use atomic exchange with RCU reclaim.

state_machines.text: Terminal path validates context, bounds faults, diverts recursive exit to dead; group reuses code else signals peers; extable tries kernel then module then accelerator.
Injection arms on unique injectable symbol, triggers probabilistically, disarms by name or blank; stacks prefer cache with RCU free; mm/task alloc init with unwind.
Creation validates/duplicates/inherits before visibility, infallible after liveness with unwind; unshare stages then commits locked; refrigerator freezes, schedules, restores.
Hung needs uninterruptible sans qualifiers, one switch, stale progress past timeout; supervisor sleeps to min(timeout,interval); lazy irq uses queues plus FIFO thread.
Coverage disabled-init-counter/compare, remote records sizing; kexec serializes, zero segments uninstalls, stages then exchanges; limits only decrease, disable one-way.

structs.text: Wait result holds pid/uid/status/cause; request joins match/target/flags/pointers/queue; injection holds list/kprobe/result; caches cover task/mm/stacks.
ABI: WEXITED/WSTOPPED/WCONTINUED, WNOHANG/WNOWAIT/WALL, P_ALL/PID/PGID/PIDFD; exit low-8; MIN/MAX_THREADS, dump filter/mask, PTRACE_MODE READ/FSCREDS/REALCREDS.
Fork spans memory/fs/ids/flags/timers; pid pairs per-level numbers with ns; hung/kcov publish controls/handles; kexec no-dest is all-ones; CLONE_VM/FS/THREAD/PIDFD/VFORK rules.
